# Izzy

## Overview

- **Age:** 18 (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Change P17](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0017)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Bess Carrow](../character/bess-carrow.md) (sibling), [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Izzy is characterized by her red hair, which she has never fully accepted, following the example of her mother. She also has gray-green eyes.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE HOLLOWMERE CHILDREN P17](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0017), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P52](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0052)_

## Personality

Izzy intends to travel to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) alongside [Bess](../character/bess-carrow.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P1](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0001)_

## Goals

- travel to Europe (since v5)  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P1](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0001)</sub>

## History

Izzy gathered with [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Bess](../character/bess-carrow.md), and [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) in [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) to chew spruce gum. During their meeting, Mary shared local gossip and revealed that [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) had killed a rooster for dinner, causing [Grace](../character/grace.md) to rush home in horror when she realized it was their pet.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVIII. MARY BRINGS EVIL TIDINGS P0](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XVIII. MARY BRINGS EVIL TIDINGS P5](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER XVIII. MARY BRINGS EVIL TIDINGS P24](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0024), [v5 CHAPTER XVIII. MARY BRINGS EVIL TIDINGS P32](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0032)_

[Bess Carrow](../character/bess-carrow.md) is Izzy's sister. They move in the same circle of local children, joining groups at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) to spend time together and chew spruce gum.
